desc: Derive the banded edit-distance recurrence for insertion, deletion, and replacement.
Specify safe indexing and boundary initialization for strings of length up to 500000.
Design an `O(K·max(|S|,|T|))` time and `O(K)` memory implementation in Python.
Verify the algorithm on equal strings, length differences, completely different strings, and the provided samples.
Produce the final stdin/stdout solution enclosed in the requested code delimiters.
